quizzes.title: Module 1 Quiz: Starting Out as a Medical VA

questions.text: What is the primary role of a Medical VA?
choices: Providing remote administrative support like scheduling and data entry

questions.text: Which of these is something a Medical VA should NEVER do?
choices: Give medical advice or a diagnosis

questions.text: Why do medical practices hire Medical VAs?
choices: To replace all licensed clinical staff
To reduce administrative burden and cost without added office overhead

questions.text: Which trait matters most for someone considering this niche?
choices: Comfort giving health advice to strangers

questions.text: What should a Medical VA do if asked about HIPAA rules they're unsure of?
choices: Ask the client for their specific privacy policy rather than assume
Look it up and present it as legal advice

quizzes.title: Module 2 Quiz: Essential Tools Every Medical VA Must Know

questions.text: What is an EHR system used for?
choices: Storing and managing patient records digitally

questions.text: Inside an EHR, what task is appropriate for a Medical VA?
choices: Updating a patient's contact and insurance details

questions.text: What is the purpose of appointment scheduling software?
choices: To keep provider calendars organized and reduce no-shows

questions.text: What does insurance verification confirm?
choices: That a patient's coverage is active for a visit

questions.text: What is prior authorization paperwork mainly about?
choices: Getting a payer's approval before certain services are covered
Diagnosing why a treatment is needed

questions.text: Why are secure messaging and fax tools used instead of regular email?
choices: They add encryption and access controls to protect patient data
They allow public sharing of patient files
They remove the need for passwords

questions.text: When transcribing a provider's dictation, what should a Medical VA do with an unclear word?
choices: Flag it for the provider to confirm rather than guessing

quizzes.title: Module 3 Quiz: Core Medical VA Administrative Skills

questions.text: What should a Medical VA do when a patient intake form is missing information?
choices: Contact the patient or flag it - never guess

questions.text: What does accurate data entry into an EHR require?
choices: Double-checking spelling and ID numbers, avoiding duplicates
Entering data as quickly as possible regardless of errors
Skipping verification steps to save time

questions.text: If a patient asks a Medical VA a clinical question during a scheduling call, what's the correct response?
choices: Professionally redirect the question to licensed clinical staff
Guess an answer to be helpful

questions.text: What is a Medical VA's role in prior authorization?
choices: Deciding whether the treatment is medically necessary
Handling the administrative paperwork and tracking its status

questions.text: What is the recommended way to communicate appointment reminders?
choices: Using an approved secure channel with a clear, professional tone
Texting from a personal, unsecured phone number without practice approval

quizzes.title: Module 4 Quiz: Building Your Medical VA Portfolio

questions.text: Why build sample administrative workflows before landing a paying client?
choices: They prove your organizational skills with concrete examples
They replace the need for a resume

questions.text: What should a mock patient intake workflow document include?
choices: Every step from form received to filed in the EHR, with an accuracy checklist

questions.text: Where can a beginner Medical VA host a portfolio for free?
choices: Canva, Carrd, or a well-organized Google Drive folder

questions.text: Why is showcasing a privacy-first approach valuable in a Medical VA portfolio?
choices: Medical practices are especially risk-averse about data handling
It has no impact on hiring decisions
It replaces the need for any real skills
Privacy doesn't apply to administrative VAs

questions.text: What belongs in a Medical VA's sample data-handling checklist?
choices: Practical habits like locking screens and using secure channels
A list of medications and dosages

quizzes.title: Module 5 Quiz: Resume and Job Application Mastery

questions.text: What should a Medical VA resume headline communicate clearly?
choices: A vague general label like 'hardworking professional'
A clear specialty, like 'Medical Virtual Assistant'
Personal hobbies unrelated to the role

questions.text: What makes a strong proposal to a medical practice?
choices: A generic message sent to every job posting
Personalization referencing the specific practice's administrative needs
Long paragraphs with no clear pricing
Avoiding any mention of privacy or confidentiality

questions.text: Where can a Medical VA look for clients?
choices: Freelance platforms, local clinics, and referrals
Nowhere - clients only come through agencies

questions.text: During a discovery call, what is a smart question to ask a potential practice client?
choices: What EHR and scheduling systems do you currently use?
How should I treat a specific symptom?

questions.text: What should a Medical VA do after a discovery call?
choices: Send a written follow-up summarizing the discussion and next steps
Wait indefinitely for the client to reach out first
Immediately demand a signed contract with no summary
Avoid following up to seem less eager

quizzes.title: Module 6 Quiz: Landing Your First Medical Client and Beyond

questions.text: What is an important step when onboarding a new medical practice client?
choices: Getting a shared login used by the whole team
Getting your own limited-access login and learning their SOPs
Skipping any discussion of privacy policy
Avoiding any onboarding conversation to start faster

questions.text: Which pricing model is most common for ongoing Medical VA support?
choices: Requiring payment in advance with no scope defined

questions.text: What should be explicitly excluded from a Medical VA's scope of work?
How can a Medical VA avoid mixing up multiple practice accounts?
choices: Use one shared login for every practice
Double-check which system is open before every entry and keep separate labeled logins
Copy templates between practices without changes

questions.text: How should a Medical VA respond to vague client feedback like 'this isn't quite right'?
choices: Ask specifically which step or field was the issue
Assume it means to redo everything from scratch
Argue that the feedback must be wrong

questions.text: What is a good sign that a Medical VA has reached full capacity?
choices: Turnaround times slow down and small errors start appearing

questions.text: What is one way to grow a long-term Medical VA career?
choices: Refusing to learn any new systems or tools
Learning additional EHR/billing systems and specializing over time
Never raising rates regardless of experience
